intro: I change the menu with the season and with what I’m making for each event. These are the main kinds of treats you can ask me about.

categories.name: Cookies
categories.shortDescription: Soft cookies, decorated cookies, and flavors that change through the year.
categories.longDescription: Soft cookies, decorated cookies, treat bags, and flavors that change throughout the year.

categories.name: Brownies & bars
categories.shortDescription: Fudgy brownies, blondies, and layered bars.
categories.longDescription: Fudgy brownies, blondies, and layered bars for sharing, or keeping to yourself.

categories.name: Dessert trays
categories.shortDescription: A mix of treats sized for your gathering.
categories.longDescription: A mix of treats sized for your party, gathering, or work event.

categories.name: Gift bags
categories.shortDescription: Small packaged treats for gifts and favors.
categories.longDescription: Small packaged treats for birthdays, holidays, favors, thank-yous, and just-because gifts.

categories.name: Jars & more
categories.shortDescription: Packaged treats and fun ideas that change often.
categories.longDescription: Cookie jars, snack mixes, and other packaged treats when I have something fun in mind.

categories.name: Seasonal specialties
categories.longDescription: Holiday flavors, themed packages, and short-run treats that only show up for a little while.
